  trigger = "click",
  value: valueProp,

  className,
  style,

    (next: string | null) => {

      activeValue,
      setActiveValue,
      setBounds,
      clearBounds,
      id,
      className,
      style,
      activeClassName,
      setActiveClassName,
      transition: resolvedTransition,
      disabled,
      enabled,
      exitDelay,

      trigger,
      activeValue,
      setActiveValue,
      setBounds,

      id,

      activeClassName,

// ─── HighlightItem ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

}
